api_base_url.label: Base URL
api_base_url.description: Base URL of the ListenBrainz API. Music Assistant appends /1 to API requests, do not include it. Leave blank to use the public ListenBrainz API.

errors.access_denied: The server refused access. Check that your user token is correct. If the server is behind a proxy or another authentication layer, check that configuration as well.
errors.connection_failed: Could not connect to the ListenBrainz server. Please check the Base URL and confirm that the server is running and reachable.
errors.endpoint_not_found: The ListenBrainz endpoint was not found. Please check the Base URL and try again.
errors.token_invalid: Your ListenBrainz user token is no longer valid. Please reconfigure this plugin to resume scrobbling.

manifest.description: Scrobbles your listening history to ListenBrainz — an open, community-driven alternative to Last.fm.
